rationale: C25 plausibly supplied substantial drafting material for the child. It assigns the Secretary of Agriculture responsibility for food and the domestic distribution of farm equipment and fertilizer; contains nearly verbatim definitions of all three; and uses the same mobilization machinery of requirements assessment, priorities and allocations, production capacity, financial assistance, and interagency coordination. C10 is a closely related antecedent with the same definitions and allocation framework, while C24 supplies the overarching emergency-preparedness-order framework and language concerning planning for all national emergencies. C25 presents the strongest combination of distinctive literal overlap and parallel operative machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: “Food resources” means all commodities and products, simple, mixed or compound, or complements to such commodities or products, that are capable of being eaten or drunk, by either human beings or animals ... at all stages of processing from the raw commodity to the products thereof in vendible form for human or animal consumption. ... [It] shall also include all starches, sugars, vegetable and animal fats and oils, cotton, tobacco, wool, mohair, hemp, flax fiber, and naval stores...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The term “food” shall mean all commodities and products, simple, mixed, or compound, or complements to such commodities or products, that are capable of being eaten or drunk by either human beings or animals ... at all stages of processing from the raw commodity to the products thereof in vendible form for human or animal consumption. ... [It] shall also include all starches, sugars, vegetable and animal fats and oils, cotton, tobacco, wool, mohair, hemp, flax fiber, and naval stores...
shared_material.explanation: This long, distinctive definition is reproduced almost verbatim from C25, with “food” adapted to “food resources.”

shared_material.child_excerpt: “Farm equipment” means machinery, equipment and repair parts manufactured primarily for use on farms in connection with the production or preparation for market or use of “food resources.” ... “Fertilizer” means any product or combination of products for plant nutrition in form for distribution to the users thereof.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The term “farm equipment” shall mean equipment manufactured for use on farms in connection with the production or processing of food. ... The term “fertilizer” shall mean fertilizer in form for distribution to the users thereof.
shared_material.explanation: The child carries forward C25's paired definitions, expanding them for the emergency-preparedness context.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Develop priorities, allocations and distribution control systems and related plans ... for the domestic distribution of farm equipment and fertilizer.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Secretary of Agriculture [shall perform the priorities-and-allocations functions] with respect to food and with respect to the domestic distribution of farm equipment and commercial fertilizer.
shared_material.explanation: The child converts C25's delegated priorities-and-allocations authority into an express preparedness-planning duty over the same assigned resources.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Periodically assemble, develop as appropriate, and evaluate requirements for assigned resources and service, taking into account the estimated needs for military, civilian, and foreign purposes.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The mobilization program covers production and related requirements, while the Secretary of Labor is directed to assemble and analyze requirements and C25 repeatedly structures allocation functions around defense and civilian needs.
shared_material.explanation: Beyond the copied definitions, both directives use the same resource-mobilization machinery: requirements assessment followed by production and allocation measures.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Secretary is hereby authorized to redelegate within the Department of Agriculture the functions hereinabove assigned to him.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Each officer or agency ... may exercise ... the power to redelegate functions, and to authorize the successive redelegation of functions, to agencies, officers, and employees of the Government.
shared_material.explanation: This supports continuity in the administrative machinery, though standing alone it would be routine boilerplate rather than sufficient evidence.
